interest_descriptions.History & Architecture 🏰: Explore Timișoara’s baroque squares, grand palaces, Orthodox and Catholic cathedrals, and a rich blend of architectural styles.
interest_descriptions.Art & Culture 🎨: Visit major art museums, cultural buildings, street-art zones and creative local galleries.
interest_descriptions.Parks & Nature 🌳: Relax in Timișoara’s famous parks, rose gardens, tree-lined promenades and peaceful green corners.
interest_descriptions.Cafés & Local Life ☕: Experience cozy cafés, student-friendly districts and vibrant everyday city life.
interest_descriptions.Food Exploration 😋: Taste Banat specialties, pastries, soups, stews and many vegetarian-friendly dishes.
interest_descriptions.Photography 📸: Capture colorful squares, baroque façades, river reflections and elegant historical details.

tour_type.afternoon: 🏛️ Victory Square (Piața Victoriei): A grand boulevard-like square with fountains, gardens and historic buildings. → | 🎭 Romanian Opera House: Striking architecture and cultural significance — great for photos. → | 🌹 Roses Park: Famous rose gardens, shade, quiet paths and relaxing natural scenery. → | 🍽️ Lunch with Banat Specialties: Hearty soups, vegetable stews, pastries and vegetarian-friendly dishes.

tour_type.night: 🌃 Riverside Cafés & Dessert Spots (Non-Alcoholic): Student-friendly cafés, warm lights along the river and relaxed evening energy.

interest_descriptions.History & Fortresses 🏰: Explore one of Romania’s most important historical strongholds — Alba Carolina, a massive star-shaped fortress full of monumental gates, bastions and centuries of heritage.
interest_descriptions.Architecture & Monuments 🏛️: Walk through elegant squares, ceremonial gates, cathedrals and beautifully restored baroque and neo-Romanesque structures.
interest_descriptions.Museums & Culture 🎨: Discover exhibitions about Transylvanian history, archaeology, royal heritage and local cultural traditions.
interest_descriptions.Parks & Nature 🌳: Enjoy peaceful fortress gardens, shady walking paths, green lawns and relaxing open spaces within and around the citadel.
interest_descriptions.Local Food Exploration 😋: Taste Transylvanian soups, dumplings, stews, pastries and vegetarian-friendly regional meals.
interest_descriptions.Photography 📸: Capture massive fortress walls, Roman ruins, ceremonial gates, sunset-lit bastions and atmospheric old-town corners.

tour_type.morning: 🏰 Alba Carolina Fortress: Start your day inside one of Eastern Europe’s most impressive star-shaped citadels — monumental gates, bastions and layers of history. → | 🏛️ Union Hall: Symbolic site of the Romanian Great Union with elegant architecture. → | 🏺 Roman Castrum Gates: See reconstructed Roman gates and archaeological remains from ancient Apulum. → | ☕ Fortress Courtyard Café: Relax in a peaceful café surrounded by historic stone walls.
tour_type.afternoon: ⛪ Coronation Cathedral: Neo-Romanesque cathedral built for the coronation of Romanian royalty — serene and elegant. → | 🖼️ National Museum of the Union: Archaeology, ethnography and heritage exhibitions. → | 🍽️ Lunch with Transylvanian Specialties: Soups, stews, dumplings, pastries and vegetarian-friendly meals.
tour_type.sunset: 🌅 Fortress Bastion Walk: Golden-hour views across the fortress and surrounding city.
tour_type.night: 🌃 Old-Town Cafés & Illuminated Fortress Walk: Peaceful dessert spots and beautifully lit evening alleys inside the citadel.
tour_type.full_day: Morning: 🏰 Alba Carolina Fortress: Monumental star-shaped citadel with historic bastions and ceremonial gates. → | 🏛️ Union Hall: Elegant landmark where the Great Union was proclaimed. → | 🏺 Roman Castrum Gates: Archaeological remains and reconstructed Roman gate structures. → | ☕ Fortress Courtyard Café: Quiet morning break in a picturesque stone-walled courtyard.; Afternoon: ⛪ Coronation Cathedral: Neo-Romanesque cathedral with symbolic national significance. → | 🖼️ National Museum of the Union: Rich collections covering archaeology, culture and Transylvanian heritage. → | 🍽️ Lunch: Traditional Transylvanian dishes including stews, soups, dumplings, pastries and vegetarian-friendly options.; Sunset: 🌅 Bastion Walk: Warm golden light over fortress walls and panoramic city edges.; Night: 🌃 Dessert Cafés & Illuminated Alleys: Cozy cafés, evening lights and peaceful fortress pathways.
